Leak detection in North Sydney & Lower North Shore — FAQs

Do you cover North Sydney & Lower North Shore?
Yes — we service all of North Sydney & Lower North Shore and its surrounding suburbs for wet-area leak detection, 6 days a week.
How soon can you get to North Sydney & Lower North Shore?
We inspect across North Sydney & Lower North Shore 6 days a week. For an active leak, call us on 1300 863 001 and we’ll find you the earliest time.
What leaks do you detect in North Sydney & Lower North Shore?
Shower, bathroom, balcony, pool, roof, ceiling and wall leaks, plus water damage and mould — wet areas only. We don’t do gas, blocked drains or CCTV pipe work.
